arxiv-2507-07200.title: Weak Optimal Transport: When is the Dual Potential convex?
arxiv-2507-07200.creator: Filip Pramenković
arxiv-2507-07200.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Filip Pramenković. Weak optimal transport generalizes the classical theory of optimal transportation to nonlinear cost functions and covers a range of problems that lie beyond the traditional theory — including entropic transport, martingale transport, and applications in mechanism design. As in the classical case, the weak transport problem can also be written as a dual maximization problem over a pair of conjugate potentials. We identify sharp monotonicity conditions on the cost under which the dual problem can be restricted to convex potentials.

uslaw-usc-t15-s7603.title: 15 U.S.C. § 7603 — Prescriber verification
uslaw-usc-t15-s7603.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s7603.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 102 (Fairness To Contact Lens Consumers). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Prescription requirement A seller may sell contact lenses only in accordance with a contact lens prescription for the patient that is— (1) presented to the seller by the patient or prescriber directly or by facsimile; or (2) verified by direct communication.

uslaw-usc-t46-s12506.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Part H (Identification Of Vessels); Chapter 125 (Vessel Identification System). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of Transportation may delegate to an agency, a State, or a qualified person the authority to— (1) establish and maintain the vessel identification system; and (2) charge fees under section 12505 of this title to a person making information.
